M-API.Summary: HTTP entry point for the department-planning application.

M-WORKER.Summary: Background processing entry point for durable document and projection jobs.

M-DATABASE.Summary: SQLite connection, WAL configuration, transactional helpers and sequential schema migration execution.

M-BACKUP.Summary: Backup verification, restore and pre-migration recovery services.

M-MIGRATION-RUNNER.Summary: Operational migration runner with automatic pre-migration backup and failure restoration.

M-GRACE-GOVERNANCE.Summary: Fail-closed policy for governed high-risk changes, observed write scope enforcement, migration immutability and SQLite integrity checks.

M-DESIGN-GOVERNANCE.Summary: Repository-level UI governance that requires design, motion decision, implementation, independent design audit and tests when a GRACE plan explicitly scopes public UI.

M-MOTION-KB.Summary: Offline semantic reference catalog and project motion policy used by specialist design agents without adding runtime dependencies.

M-CI-GATE.Summary: Risk-selected GitHub Actions gate: ordinary changes use one compact project check, while GRACE and database/recovery verification run only for explicitly governed risk.

M-OFFLINE-BUNDLE.Summary: Full offline distribution build verified for release and installer/update risk rather than every feature pull request.

DF-GRACE-BRANCH.Summary: High-risk flow from issue and exact-main branch through approved C-* scope, GRACE final lint, relevant risk evidence, compact project CI and squash merge.

DF-DESIGN-CHANGE.Summary: UI flow from product design and motion/no-motion decision through implementation, independent design audit and targeted responsive/reduced-motion tests; GRACE wraps it only when the change is otherwise high-risk.

DF-DATABASE-UPGRADE.Summary: Base revision database to pre-migration backup, HEAD migration, integrity verification and restorable baseline evidence.
